# PI Dashboard

> Open-source, self-hosted web and mobile dashboard for the pi coding agent. It mirrors every pi session to the browser as it runs: read the transcript, answer the prompt, abort a runaway, run agents in parallel, and take over from your phone. MIT licensed.

PI Dashboard works only with the pi coding agent (https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono). It is not a front-end for other coding agents.

## Links

- [Website](https://pi-dashboard.dev/): overview, downloads and install routes
- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/pi-agent-dashboard): source, README and documentation
- [Releases](https://github.com/BlackBeltTechnology/pi-agent-dashboard/releases): desktop installers for macOS, Linux and Windows
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@blackbelt-technology/pi-agent-dashboard): `npm install -g @blackbelt-technology/pi-agent-dashboard`
- [pi coding agent](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono): the upstream agent the dashboard controls

## Install

- Desktop app: download an installer from the releases page; it bundles Node.js and installs pi.
- pi package: inside a pi session, run `/packages add @blackbelt-technology/pi-agent-dashboard`.
- npm: `npm install -g @blackbelt-technology/pi-agent-dashboard`, then `pi-dashboard start` (needs Node.js 20+ and a working pi).
